name: PathologyAlphaPathologyCodes
title: Pathology Alpha - Local Pathology Order Codes
description: Local pathology order codes used by Pathology Alpha's laboratory information system. These codes are used internally for ordering pathology tests and need to be mapped to the national pathology reference set for interoperability.

concept.definition: Complete blood count including WBC, RBC, Hb, Hct, platelets
Renal function panel including urea, sodium, potassium, creatinine
Hepatic function panel including ALT, AST, ALP, GGT, bilirubin, albumin
Thyroid panel including TSH, free T3, free T4
Random or fasting blood glucose measurement
Lipid panel including total cholesterol, HDL, LDL, triglycerides
Coagulation screening including PT, APTT, INR
Serum ferritin measurement for iron stores
Blood gas analysis including pH, pO2, pCO2, HCO3
